programme.title: The FBI Files: Hidden Agenda

programme.title: Up In The Air
programme.desc: Ryan Bingham lever et høytsvevende liv. Han flyr over hele verden på forretningsreiser og er stadig på farten. Men så treffer han medpassasjeren Alex og lærer at livet ikke handler om reisen, men kontaktene man oppnår langs veien.

programme.title: Legend
programme.desc: I en tidløs, mytisk skog er Jack utvalgt av skjebnen tilå redde den nydelige Prinsesse Lili og beseire dendemoniske Mørkets Fyrste. Hvis ikke kastes verden ut ievigvarende istid. Med Tom Cruise, Mia Sara og Tim Curry.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: En inspirerende fortelling om basketballtrener Ken Carter, som fikk både ris og ros da han skapte overskrifter med å sette hele sitt ubeseirede lag på benken på grunn av dårlige akademiske prestasjoner.

programme.title: Youth in Revolt

programme.title: Midnight in Paris
programme.desc: Paris om morgenen er vakker. Paris om ettermiddagen er sjarmerende. Paris om kvelden er fortryllende. Men - Paris etter midnatt er magisk!

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa .5
programme.desc: advarsel: denne helt nye filmen inkluderer helt nytt innhold som er uklippet, skandaløst og fullstendig upassende! Bad Grandpa .5 gir deg et helt nytt perspektiv på Irving Zismans verden med utrolige bonusscener og morsomme skøyerstreker.

programme.title: American Siege
programme.desc: Den avdankede sheriffen i en liten by i Georgia, Ben Watts, blir presset til raskt å løse en gisselsituasjon – og innser snart at han er en brikke i et større spill blant byens skumle hemmeligheter.

programme.title: 97 Minutes

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Jeopardy Room

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Midnight Sun
programme.desc: The Earth's orbit has been changed, drawing ever closer to the sun and promising imminent destruction.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Trade-Ins
programme.desc: An elderly couple visit the New Life Corporation, hoping to transport their personalities into youthful artificial bodies.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Uncle Simon
programme.desc: Barbara accidentally causes her cruel Uncle Simon's death. His will stipulates that she must care for his latest invention - a robot. The robot begins to take on Uncle Simon's traits.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Four O'Clock
programme.desc: Oliver Crangle is a bitter, prejudiced man. Through unknown means, he intends to shrink every evil person in the world at four o'clock.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The 7th is Made Up of Phantoms
programme.desc: Three National Guardsmen explore the site of Custer's Last Stand and encounter mysterious phenomenon that hint at the original battle occurring just out of sight.

programme.title: Cool World

programme.title: Vår, sommer, høst, vinter... og vår
programme.desc: I en flytende eneboerhytte i vill koreansk natur blir en gutt veiledet gjennom livets faser av en gammel munk. Men når gutten møter kjærlighet, begjær og vold, settes alt på spill. En poetisk fortelling om visdom, prøvelser og livets evige kretsløp.

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: Dark Star NO
programme.desc: Det er midten av 2000-tallet, og mennesket har utforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forlatt jorden for å finne nye hjem i universet. Det væpnede romskipet "Dark Star" skal bane vei for alle de fredelige kolonistene.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Last of the Mochicas
programme.desc: På jakt etter et søramerikansk Mochica-indisk beskyttelsesrester, blir Nigel og hans kolleger fanget av lokale geriljaer. Det er opp til Sydney og alliert Jason Clark å redde dem.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Fertile Ground
programme.desc: Sydney gjenforenes med kjæresten på videregående skole for å spore et hawaiisk fruktbarhetsidol på Madagaskar.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Gypsy Jigsaw

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bloodlust
programme.desc: For homicide investigators, it's a race against time as they track their deadliest foe: a serial killer for whom killing is the only way to feel alive.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Random Targets
programme.desc: Most victims of multiple murderers are meticulously chosen because of a mutual connection with the killer or because they match an intricate set of criteria that fits the killer's MO.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: Wonder Boys
programme.desc: En engelsk professor prøver å takle at kona forlater ham, ankomsten til redaktøren hans som har ventet på boka hans i syv år, og de forskjellige problemene som vennene og kollegene hans drar ham inn i.

programme.title: Snowden
programme.desc: Manuset er basert på bøkene The Snowden Files: The Inside Story of the World's Most Wanted Man av Luke Harding og Time of the Octopus av Anatoly Kucherena.

programme.title: The Shamrock Spitfire
programme.desc: Den sanne historien om den irske jagerpiloten Brendan «Paddy» Finucane, som bare 21 år gammel ble tidenes yngste oberstløytnant i Royal Air Force, og som skvadronsjef et av de største og mest berømte flyveressene i andre verdenskrig.

programme.title: The Good Heart
programme.desc: Jacques er eier av en hardbarket bar i New York som fungerer som et slags hjem for et broket utvalg av profesjonelle drankere. Jacques prøver målbevisst å drikke og røyke seg til døde når han møter Lucas, en hjemløs, ung mann som allerede har gitt opp…

programme.title: A Merry Holiday
programme.desc: Christy, en svært vellykket selger, stresser med å få en stor avtale. For å hjelpe henne må hun slå seg sammen med Jonathan som er opptatt med å lage en magisk jul for kjæresten sin. Konflikten er gitt, men noe annet begynner også å gry...

programme.title: Fortress
programme.desc: Den tidligere CIA-agenten Robert bor på et hemmelig feriested for tidligere spioner. Nå er hans sønn Paul havnet i trøbbel og trenger hans hjelp. Dessverre er ikke Pauls planer så hemmelige som livet til faren.

programme.title: The Ice Road
programme.desc: Etter at en fjerntliggende diamantgruve kollapser i Nord-Canada tar Mike oppdraget med å lede redningsoperasjonen, og må trosse de brutale naturkreftene i Canadas villmark.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Long Live Walter Jameson
programme.desc: Walter Jameson is an excellent history teacher who talks about the past as if he had lived it.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Ninety Years Without Slumbering
programme.desc: An old man fears that he will die if his grandfather clock stops running.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: One for the Angels
programme.desc: A street salesman cleverly eludes Death. But if he lives, a little girl must die in his place.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Last Flight
programme.desc: A World War I flying ace flies through a mysterious cloud - and lands at a modern U.S. airbase in the year 1959!

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Noen har ført kjærligheten din til oppfølgerne for langt! Favorittkomirollene til Scary Movie er tilbake i en film som skremmer opp enda mer ærbødig moro enn originalen med sitt syn på klisjéhjemsøkte thrillere.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Bewitchin' Pool
programme.desc: Two unhappy children find a happy escape in a swimming pool.

programme.title: Explorers
programme.desc: In their makeshift laboratory, three boys use an amazing discovery and their ingenuity to build their own spaceship and launch themselves on a fantastic interplanetary journey.

programme.title: Frøkens Kjæledegge
programme.desc: Clark Gable plays Jim Gannon, a school-of-hard-knocks newspaperman who despises journalism schools, until he sees who's doing the teaching.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butikkmedarbeider oppdager en mystisk plante med en blodtørstig appetitt. Suksess følger, men prisen viser seg å være menneskeliv, og situasjonen eskalerer.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hjemmebranner
programme.desc: En planet av Commonwealth-overlevende ledet av Dylans tidligere forlovede blir invitert til å bli med i det nye Commonwealth, men når de stemmer for ikke å bli med, blir Magog mistenkt for å ha spilt skittent.

programme.title: Andromeda: Inn i labyrinten
programme.desc: En avgrunnsagent prøver å lokke Harper til å bli med i Magog

programme.title: Andromeda: Prinsen

programme.title: Mutant X: Crossroads of the Soul

programme.title: Mutant X: Sign from Above
programme.desc: Tre utenomjordiske personer som utgjør en alvorlig trussel mot menneskeheten, retter seg mot Shalimar, så teamet satser på å redde henne fra sine onde klør.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dead Run
programme.desc: In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

programme.title: The FBI Files: First and Kennedy Street Crew

programme.title: The New Detectives: True Crime

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The After Hours

programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.title: The Kingdom

Culture shock and opposition from local law enforcement combine to hinder his progress and that of his elite team, but a sympathetic Saudi police captain becomes an unexpected comrade-in-arms.

programme.title: Assault on Precinct 13
programme.desc: While en route to prison, a bus carrying criminals Marion (Laurence Fishburne), Beck (John Leguizamo) and Anna (Aisha Hinds) is rerouted to Detroit's soon-to-be-closed Precinct 13 because of a dangerous winter storm. All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men.

programme.title: Self/less
programme.desc: Billionaire industrialist Damian Hale (Ben Kingsley) is master of his universe, until he encounters a foe that he can't defeat: cancer. His only hope is a radical medical procedure called "shedding," in which his consciousness is transferred to a healthy body. After the procedure, Damian, now called Edward (Ryan Reynolds), starts a new life in New Orleans, but he's plagued by disturbing images. When he delves into Edward's mysterious origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

programme.title: The Eagle
programme.desc: Under the command of Flavius Aquila in A.D. 120, Rome's Ninth Legion marches north carrying its revered eagle emblem and vanishing into the mists. Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy

Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks

Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Firestarter

Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop."

The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: Metalocalypse

programme.title: Metalocalypse

programme.title: Metalocalypse

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The world economy is crumbling and waiting for the next Dethklok album to stimulate it back into order. It's up to Dethklok to get the album just right and finished on time.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After the attack on Mordhaus, Dethklok is left without a manager and plagued by greedy record execs and forced to face the brutality of the slumping economy while dabbling in interior design. programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok joins their own Dethklok tribute band as a last ditch effort to connect with their rock and roll roots.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After a near-death experience, Dethklok realizes they would rather be sick and not know then face the brutality of going to a doctor. Meanwhile Nathan tries to brave the brutality of going to the dentist and Murderface faces the possibility of being gay after accidentally ejaculating on a doctors face. Part of Season 3.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok must experience the ultimate brutality of the Holiday season; spending time with their MOTHERS. programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After an onslaught of paternity suits, Skwisgaar realizes he will never change until he quits the band to find his father who abandoned him before birth.Meanwhile, Dethklok realizes they all have father abandonment issues and Murderface decides to repair the damages by appointing himself "Band Father."

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki falls head over heals for a girl he meets online. When things sour he tries to break it off and instead has to bear the brutality of being her date at her father's vegan funeral in 110 degree heat. Meanwhile Nathan experiences the brutality of dating a performance artist. And Murderface must attend a sexual harassment seminar after trying to match Skwisgaar's sexual prowess.

programme.title: Metalocalypse

programme.title: Metalocalypse

programme.title: Metalocalypse

programme.title: Metalocalypse

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Despite his bandmates' warnings, Nathan begins seriously dating one of his fans. Meanwhile, the rest of the band starts smoking after Murderface lands the cover of Smokaroonie Aficionado.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After Dethklok is accused of being racist at a huge press conference, they combat the charges by opening an Urban Youth Dethcenter. programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: With their new album finally shipping, Dethklok plans their post-release traditions of vacationing, goofing off, palling around, and prank calls. programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok heads to Tomahawk, Wisconsin to open a Dethfair in hopes that it will stimulate the economy they destroyed. Pickles uses this time at home to reconnect with his disapproving mother who tells him that she won't respect him until he gets a real job. Pickles decides to hang up his drumsticks and goes into an even more brutal profession: he becomes a realtor.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Tired of taking verbal abuse from his bandmate, Toki writes a tell-all book called Skwisgaar Is Ams Dick and takes over as Dethklok's lead guitarist. But can Toki handle the spotlight? Meanwhile, Nathan buys a new favorite toy for the band: a defibrillator.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After spending all their time with sluts and squandering the budget on their new record, Dethklok is shocked to find they've been assigned a new producer: A WOMAN. She sends them on a pre-writing vacation that turns out to be a brutal trip to a third world country where they're mistaken as women and captured as sex slaves.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In an effort to make friends, Toki goes to Rockaroonie Fantasy Camp - a weekend getaway to rub elbows with rock and roll royalty (but he attends as a camper.)
